title: Three-dimensional microangiography of the mouse brain using super-resolution ultrasound and optoacoustic imaging with a spherical array transducer
authors: Daniil Nozdriukhin; Yi Chen; Cristian Ciobanu; Elshad Feyzili; Daniel Razansky; Xosé Luís Deán-Ben

summary_en: This work performs a controlled three-dimensional comparison of ultrasound and optoacoustic microangiography, including ultrasound localization microscopy and localization optoacoustic tomography, with the same spherical array, localization and tracking algorithms, and acquisition rate. The modalities show complementary strengths: optoacoustic imaging provides higher-SNR cortical visualization, while ultrasound reaches deeper and supports whole-brain coverage. The shared hardware and matched reconstruction setting make it a strong core acoustic-optical imaging contribution.

summary_en: This paper introduces an infinity-reflection optical cavity for beam-deflection ultrasound sensing. Repeated probe-beam round trips extend the effective acousto-optic interaction length and yield a 3.5-fold sensitivity improvement over conventional single-pass detection. Demonstrations in phantom and in-vivo photoacoustic microscopy make it a direct and strong core addition for optical ultrasound sensing and acousto-optic imaging.
